fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vm" and "kill" flag in order to kill/shutdown a specific VM.
fields.name: ESXi VM Kill Via ESXCLI
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/esxcli" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "vm process" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "kill")))
